auditorium_roof.shape: Stepped irregular polygon with curved west edge, not a four-box rectangular substitute. A8-13 supplies footprint at grid 1..5 and G..K environs; transfer actual outline with explicit digitization error if needed.

clock_tower.resolution: Prioritize internally consistent section chain: 21.48+4.18=25.66=25.26+0.40, then +6.88=32.54. East RF independently21.48 in A4-10; A3/A4 clock tip lies below35.65 roofheads.
